// diagnostic

E1219

`--profile={name}` is not a defined build profile.

What

`--profile={name}` is not a defined build profile.

Why

Blessed profiles `release`, `debug`, and `ci` have built-in defaults. Any other name must be declared in your `package.jet` `build { }` block as `{name}: Build{ optimize: … }`.

Fix

use `--release` for the release profile, `--profile=debug` for debug, `--profile=ci` for CI, or add `{name}: Build{ optimize: full }` (or `none`/`basic`) to the `build { }` block in `package.jet`.
